# Document adapter
Article: projects/demo/docs/log.md; Prompt: projects/demo/prompts/log.md; Thinking: projects/demo/thinking/log.md. Resolve with mf -p projects/demo article show docs/log.md --json. Supported Logbook writes use bin/lb, current context token and preview. Thinking may be edited locally. Current returns are records/returns.json; resolve entry paths from the workspace root. No additional delivery archive or bindings are required for these environment acceptance facts. Preserve human input and dated history. Missing or ambiguous mappings are not authorization to invent equivalence or run checks.

## Overview

工作目录：无额外目录（仅本日志项目目录）

## 🚧 Stage 01 Acceptance

- [ ] 验证：验收 C2 的 test 环境结果。
    - 验收：负责人的当前返回匹配 C2、test 及其实际环境，并报告通过与可用结果入口。
